# Tests must verify values that exist, not equal missing properties

D203232 caught misspelled array lengths that made a test pass because undefined == undefined. Use the actual .length and verify meaningful selection state when the select event fires. Include an assertion explanation that names the expected behavior; account-color review also moved explanations into assertion messages. No runtime was run here; this is a failure lesson from reviewed tests.

Scope: test assertions.

Paths:

- `mail/base/test/widgets/browser_treeListbox.js`
- `mail/test/browser/account/browser_accountColors.js`

[Shared lesson record](../records/a6fb2c4a191866805f8f01e5105dce90958af5d62797389d8e387159ce503472.json).
